title: Output of references-plan: the reference images of ONE video plan, and at most two missing assets

references.description: The full, final list of reference images for the plan, in order: speakers first, then other characters, props, effects, keyframes, the set last. Start from `dejaChoisis`, keep what is right, add what is missing, remove what is wrong. Codes copied EXACTLY from `candidats` or `assetsProposesParLeLot`. One face per character. At most `limiteImages` together with `manquants`.

pourquoi.description: (French) A few words: why this image is in the plan.

manquants.description: Assets the plan really needs and that NO candidate or proposed asset can play. Usually empty. Never a sound, a voice or an effect.

code.description: Proposed code: the prefix of its type (CHAR_, DEC_, PROP_, KEY_, OTH_), then lowercase words joined by _. Must not exist yet.

parent.description: For a STATE of an existing subject (the same set at night, the same prop broken): the code of that subject, same type. Otherwise null.

description.description: (French) What is seen, as in the registry: appearance only, no framing, no action.

notes.description: (French) One or two short sentences on the doubts you settled. Empty if nothing to say.
